title: Public Record Intake Manifest
mission: Feed Matrix Reprogrammed with source-first public records, not unsupported claims. Each lane tells the machine where to look, what record type matters, what control layer it touches, and what evidence grade it can support.
boundary: A feed route is not proof by itself. The machine must keep records, allegations, hypotheses, and unsupported claims separate.

intake_lanes.name: Federal Register policy and rulemaking feed
intake_lanes.machine_use: Track proposed rules, final rules, agency notices, emergency powers, identity systems, financial rules, security policy, health policy and disclosure notices.

intake_lanes.name: SEC EDGAR filings and company facts
intake_lanes.machine_use: Track company filings, ownership disclosures, risk factors, contracts, subsidiaries, executive changes, material events, and XBRL facts.

intake_lanes.name: CourtListener / Free Law legal records
intake_lanes.source_type: legal records API / bulk data route
intake_lanes.machine_use: Track lawsuits, opinions, dockets, legal parties, judicial records, public conflicts and follow-up record requests.

intake_lanes.name: USAspending federal awards and contracts
intake_lanes.machine_use: Track contracts, grants, recipients, award amounts, agencies, subcontracting routes, emergency spending and public-private control routes.

intake_lanes.name: Regulations.gov dockets and comments
intake_lanes.machine_use: Track comments, supporting documents, agency dockets, influence campaigns and public-private policy pressure.

intake_lanes.name: FEC campaign finance data
intake_lanes.machine_use: Track donors, committees, independent expenditures, candidate funding routes and political money patterns.

intake_lanes.name: US Senate lobbying disclosure data
intake_lanes.machine_use: Track lobbying clients, registrants, policy issues, spending totals and policy pressure routes.

intake_lanes.name: OFAC sanctions list data
intake_lanes.machine_use: Track sanctioned entities, aliases, programs, jurisdictions, identifiers and money-control routes.

intake_lanes.name: EU TED public procurement notices
intake_lanes.machine_use: Track EU tenders, awards, contractors, public infrastructure, health procurement, border systems, digital ID and surveillance contracts.

intake_lanes.name: UK Companies House company filings
intake_lanes.machine_use: Track companies, directors, persons with significant control, filings, incorporations, dissolutions and network routes.

intake_lanes.name: World Bank projects and procurement
intake_lanes.machine_use: Track development finance, projects, procurement, policy programs, NGOs, contractors and institutional money routes.

intake_lanes.name: News signal intake - not evidence by itself
intake_lanes.machine_use: Detect patterns, headlines and narrative shifts. This lane can trigger record searches but cannot prove claims by itself.

machine_tasks: For every live-intel drop, attach at least one source lane and one missing-record question.
For every person or institution, attach a filings route, court route, contract route, policy route, or registry route where possible.
For every claim, assign the evidence ladder before showing it as a finding.
For every news signal, search for the primary record before upgrading the evidence grade.
For every clock movement, name the record that would confirm or reduce the risk score.
